rows.contract: The Debug panel allows validation when applicable, supplies an availability explanation and locks renderer startup settings while powered on.
rows.native_mapping: Native UI names Metal API Validation and explains launch-time enablement when not enabled for the current process. Reuses saved renderer_debug.
rows.expected_result: Real Qt offscreen validation label, state transitions, startup dialog and running lockout.
rows.actual_result: Actual Qt native/feature-off compiled and native widget linked. Validation and capture independent, retranslate and running lockout verified. Native physical capture pending. PICA 48/801 and CTest 64 passes.

rows.actual_result: Actual Qt native/feature-off compiled and native widget linked. Validation and capture independent, retranslate and running lockout verified. Native physical capture pending. PICA 48/801 and CTest 64 passes.

rows.contract: Validation and capture are distinct optional diagnostics, can be disabled independently, and failures are explicit.
